title: Greenhouse telemetry ingest: a batch validator that lets non-numbers through
name: Telemetry batch validation

questions.prompt: Since sensor firmware 4.2 rolled out to part of the fleet, the greenhouse dashboard shows temperature averages like 1010.8 °C, and some soil moisture charts drop to 0 for minutes at a time. The ingest API accepted every one of those batches with 202. Fix telemetry/validate.ts so the tests pass.
